core_obligations: Choose a countable subfield k of K and enumerate all systems over k satisfying (1)-(3) up to isomorphism; base change to K.

Property (4): a K-linear equivalence is represented by a FM kernel (same-chapter representation proposition), its right adjoint and compositions identify the kernel as a relative equivalence via the in-batch cards.
Descending: write K as a filtered colimit of finitely generated subalgebras, descend X, Y and M after enlarging A, and match the descended system with the enumerated list.
proof_roadmap: Enumerate over the prime field, verify property (4) through the kernel category, then run the limits descent to land in the enumeration.
difficulty_reason: Countability assembly over a countable subfield plus a descent argument along finitely generated subalgebras; multi-lemma coordination.
